title: Square Roots
summary: Finding square roots by prime factors and estimation, and meeting irrational numbers like √2.

ib.note: Square roots and irrational numbers are MYP 3 Number

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Ch 1: A Square and A Cube
Earlier NCERT Ch 5: Squares and Square Roots

objectives: I can find square roots of perfect squares using prime factorisation.
I can estimate square roots between whole numbers.
I can solve problems involving squares and square roots.
misconceptions: Every square root is a whole number or a simple fraction.
